title: Survey model
description: Contour rings of a noise island rise off a slate plinth into a stacked survey model. A kernel traces each ring by bisecting the height along rays from the peak and writes its points into one set of lines, which draws every ring as a lit enamel tube in one draw, every fifth ring bold, dashing the soundings below the shoreline. A graticule of hairlines a point wide is printed on the plinth, beside a north arrow and a scale bar, and the rings cast a soft shadow under the sun. TAA and bloom finish the picture. Point at a ring to pick it out.
line: Contour rings traced by a kernel, drawn as lit tubes in one draw of lines.
hint: point at a ring · drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
